en.text: Externalities

zh.text: 界外效應

en.text: Which of the following implies a divergence between private and social costs?

zh.text: 下列哪一項意味著私人成本與社會成本之間出現分歧？

en.text: Male students contribute money towards buying perfumes for female students.

zh.text: 男學生提供貨幣，合資為女學生購買香水。

en.text: A student accidentally pours coffee on a professor’s jacket and says sorry.

zh.text: 一名學生不小心把咖啡潑在教授的外套上，並表示抱歉。

en.text: A husband complains about his wife all the time but refuses to get a divorce.

zh.text: 一名丈夫經常抱怨他的妻子，但拒絕離婚。

en.text: A piano player who never receives any payment for his music from his neighbour always plays the piano up to the point that the marginal value of his piano play to his neighbour is zero.

zh.text: 一位鋼琴手從未因其音樂而獲得鄰居的任何付款，但他總是彈奏鋼琴，直至其演奏對鄰居的邊際價值為零為止。

en.text: HKALE 1999 Paper 1 Q27

zh.text: 香港高級程度會考 1999 卷一 第 27 題

en.text: In which of the following situations will there be
NO
divergence between private and social costs / benefits?

zh.text: 在以下哪種情況下，私人與社會成本／利益之間
不會
出現分離？

en.text: A chemical factory upstream pollutes a river without considering the damage inflicted upon fish farmers downstream.

zh.text: 一家位於上游的化學廠污染河流，而沒有考慮對下游養魚戶造成的損害。

en.text: A diner smokes in a restaurant without considering the effects on people nearby.

zh.text: 一名食客在餐廳內吸煙，而沒有考慮對附近人士造成的影響。

en.text: A farmer raises some sheep which damage the crops of nearby farmland owned by the farmer.

zh.text: 一名農民飼養羊隻，牠們破壞了附近由該農民擁有的土地上的農作物。

en.text: A pianist plays the piano at home and receives no payment from his neighbour who enjoys the music.

zh.text: 一名鋼琴家在家中彈奏鋼琴，而欣賞該音樂的鄰居並沒有向他支付費用。

en.text: HKDSE Sample Paper Paper 1 Q18

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 樣本試卷 卷一 第 18 題

en.text: A beekeeper keeps the bees for their honey. The bee-keeping benefits the farmers in the orchard nearby because the bees help pollinate the fruits in the orchard. Which of the following statements about this case is correct?

zh.text: 養蜂者養蜂是為了獲取蜂蜜。養蜂對附近果園的農民有利，因爲蜜蜂幫助果園的果樹傳播花粉。下列哪項有關上述個案的陳述是正確的？

en.text: There will be a divergence between private and social benefits and the honey is over-produced.

zh.text: 私人和社會得益分歧會出現，而蜂蜜會過度生產。

en.text: The beekeeper should be subsidized by the government to improve economic efficiency.

zh.text: 養蜂者應獲政府補貼以改善經濟效率。

en.text: If the value of honey is higher than the value of fruits, there is no need for the government to intervene to correct the externality.

zh.text: 若蜂蜜的價值高於水果的價值，政府毋須介入改正界外效應。

en.text: There will be no divergence between private and social benefits if the orchard nearby is owned by the beekeeper.

zh.text: 若附近果園屬該養蜂者所擁有，私人和社會得益分歧不會出現。

en.text: HKDSE 2013 Paper 1 Q20

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2013 卷一 第 20 題

en.text: Korean pop singers are becoming more popular in Hong Kong. To these singers, which of the following are their private benefits?

zh.text: 韓國的流行歌手在香港越來越受歡迎。對這些歌手來說，下列哪些屬於他們的私人得益？

en.text: (1) and (3) only
(1) and (4) only
(2) and (3) only
(2) and (4) only
the rise in royalties from the sales of their albums

zh.text: 出售他們的唱片所得的版稅收入增加了。

en.text: the rise in sales revenue of Korean-designed fashion

zh.text: 韓國所設計的服裝其銷售收益增加了。

en.text: the rise in the number of tourists visiting Korea

zh.text: 到訪韓國的遊客人數增加了。

en.text: the rise in revenue shared from their concerts held in Hong Kong

zh.text: 他們在香港舉行演唱會所分成的收益增加了。

en.text: HKDSE 2014 Paper 1 Q18

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2014 卷一 第 18 題

en.text: Which of the following are ways to lessen the problem of divergence between private and social costs in Hong Kong?

zh.text: 在香港，下列哪些是減輕私人與社會成本分歧這個問題的方法？

en.text: (1) and (3) only
(1) and (4) only
(2) and (3) only
(2) and (4) only
to collect a sewage charge

zh.text: 收取排污費

en.text: to collect a university tuition fee

zh.text: 收取大學學費

en.text: to collect a charge on electricity

zh.text: 收取電費

en.text: to collect a levy on plastic bags

zh.text: 對使用膠袋徵費

en.text: HKDSE 2014 Paper 1 Q19

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2014 卷一 第 19 題

en.text: Which of the following is an example of the divergence between private and social benefits?

zh.text: 下列哪項是私人利益和社會利益分歧的一個例子？

en.text: A security guard watches live concerts when he is working in a concert hall.

zh.text: 一名保安員在演奏廳當值時觀看到現場音樂會。

en.text: A tourist enjoys the music performed by a singer on the street and he does not pay for that.

zh.text: 一名遊客欣賞街頭歌手的音樂表演而沒有付費。

en.text: A resident living next to a karaoke lounge cannot fall asleep because of the noise.

zh.text: 一名住在卡拉 OK 酒廊隔鄰的居民因噪音不能入睡。

en.text: After the removal of the airport, the market value of the residential flats in that region increases.

zh.text: 機場遷離後，該地區的住宅樓宇的市場價值上升。

en.text: HKDSE 2015 Paper 1 Q17

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2015 卷一 第 17 題

en.text: Recently, unmanned aircraft systems have become very popular but using those aircrafts in urban areas has caused noise and safety concerns. The Civil Aviation Department is considering regulating the manufacture, import and sale of unmanned aircraft systems.

zh.text: 近年，無人飛行系統變得十分普及，但在市區使用這些飛行器引起人們對它在噪音和安全方面的關注。民航處正考慮對生產、進口和銷售無人飛行系統作出監管。

en.text: It is an example of divergence between private and social _______ and the _______ solution is being considered to reduce the divergence.

zh.text: 這是私人和社會 ______ 分歧的一個例子，而 ______ 的方法正被考慮用作減少該分歧。

en.text: costs ... market

zh.text: 成本 …… 市場

en.text: costs ... government

zh.text: 成本 …… 政府

en.text: benefits ... market

zh.text: 利益 …… 市場

en.text: benefits ... government

zh.text: 利益 …… 政府

en.text: HKDSE 2018 Paper 1 Q23

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2018 卷一 第 23 題

en.text: With reference to the above information, which of the following statements is correct?

zh.text: 參考以上資料，下列哪項陳述是正確的？

en.text: Children screaming in the café results in negative externality and all cafés should introduce similar policy to restore efficiency.

zh.text: 小孩在咖啡店尖叫引致負面界外影響，而所有咖啡店應該採取相似的政策以回復效率。

en.text: The extra charge on screaming children increases the marginal private cost of the groups with screaming children.

zh.text: 對小孩尖叫的額外收費增加有尖叫小孩的人士的邊際私人成本。

en.text: The ‘screaming child tax’ is a government solution to the divergence between private and social costs.

zh.text: 「小孩尖叫稅」是政府解決私人成本和社會成本分歧的一種方法。

en.text: The ‘screaming child tax’ is a kind of discrimination and should not be imposed.

zh.text: 「小孩尖叫稅」是一種歧視，因此不應實施。

en.text: HKDSE 2020 Paper 1 Q21

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2020 卷一 第 21 題

en.text: Which of the following will most likely be the positive external effect of the opening of the full Tuen Ma Line of MTR?

zh.text: 下列哪項最有可能是港鐵屯馬綫全綫通車引起的正面外部影響？

en.text: The travel time is shortened for MTR passengers.

zh.text: 港鐵乘客的乘車時間縮短。

en.text: The business of restaurants near the stations of MTR Tuen Ma Line rises.

zh.text: 港鐵屯馬綫車站附近餐廳的生意上升。

en.text: The problem of noise pollution worsens.

zh.text: 噪音污染問題惡化。

en.text: The income of minibus drivers drops.

zh.text: 小巴司機的收入下降。

en.text: HKDSE 2022 Paper 1 Q22

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2022 卷一 第 22 題

en.text: Plastic straws are a major source of plastic waste. Most plastic straws would break into smaller particles, releasing chemicals which threaten the environment.

zh.text: 塑膠飲管是塑膠廢料的主要源頭。大部分塑膠飲管會分解成較細小的粒子，釋出危害環境的化學物質。

en.text: Based on the above information, which of the following statements is correct?

zh.text: 根據以上資料，下列哪項陳述是正確的？

en.text: The use of plastic straws results in negative externality, and the quantity of plastic straws used is below the efficient level.

zh.text: 塑膠飲管的使用引致負面界外影響，而塑膠飲管的使用量低於效率水平。

en.text: To maximise total social surplus, governments around the world should completely ban the use of plastic straws.

zh.text: 為達至總社會盈餘極大化，各地政府應全面禁止使用塑膠飲管。

en.text: Charging a lump-sum tax on the businesses that provide plastic straws to customers must restore efficiency in the market of plastic straws.

zh.text: 對提供塑膠飲管予顧客的業務徵收一項定額稅，必然可以回復塑膠飲管市場的效率。

en.text: Granting a per-unit subsidy to the producers of environmentally-friendly paper straws tends to reduce the deadweight loss in the market of plastic straws.

zh.text: 向環保紙飲管生產者提供從量補貼，傾向降低塑膠飲管市場的效率損失。

en.text: HKDSE 2023 Paper 1 Q22

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2023 卷一 第 22 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about overproduction is/are correct?

zh.text: 下列哪項／些關於過度生產的陳述是正確的？

en.text: (2) only

zh.text: 只有(2)

en.text: (3) only

zh.text: 只有(3)

en.text: (2) and (3) only
Overproduction of a good occurs when there is an excess supply of the good.

zh.text: 當某物品有超額供應時，該物品會出現過度生產。

en.text: Overproduction does not occur whenever the market is at equilibrium.

zh.text: 每當市場處於均衡狀態時，便不會出現過度生產。

en.text: When overproduction occurs, the marginal social cost is greater than the marginal social benefit at the last unit.

zh.text: 當過度生產出現時，最後一單位的邊際社會成本大於邊際社會利益。

en.text: HKDSE 2024 Paper 1 Q19

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2024 卷一 第 19 題

en.text: In recent years, more and more people play videos loudly with their smartphones on public transport, disturbing other passengers.

zh.text: 近年，越來越多人在公共交通工具上用智能電話大聲地播放影片，對其他乘客造成滋擾。

en.text: Based on the above information, which of the following statements are correct?

zh.text: 根據上述資料，下列哪些陳述是正確的？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
Total social surplus may decrease if playing videos loudly with smartphones on public transport is banned by the government.

zh.text: 假如政府禁止在公共交通工具上用智能電話大聲地播放影片，總社會盈餘可能會下降。

en.text: Economic efficiency may improve if suppliers of public transportation services designate quiet zones in their vehicles where passengers are not allowed to play videos loudly with their smartphones.

zh.text: 假如公共交通服務的供應者在其交通工具上設立靜音區，不准乘客在靜音區內用智能電話大聲地播放影片，經濟效率可能會有所改善。

en.text: The divergence between private and social costs may decrease if people playing videos loudly with their smartphones on public transport are fined.

zh.text: 假如在公共交通工具上用智能電話大聲地播放影片會被罰款，私人成本與社會成本的分歧可能會下降。

en.text: HKDSE 2024 Paper 1 Q22

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2024 卷一 第 22 題

en.text: A developer plans to construct a tall building. The building will block the sea view enjoyed by some households living in another building.

zh.text: 某發展商計劃興建一座高聳的建築物。該建築物將會擋着另一座建築物部分住戶享有的海景。

en.text: In the above situation, efficiency may be attained if _______.

zh.text: 在上述情況中，若 ______，則可能達至有效率。

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
the government restricts the height of the new building

zh.text: 政府限制該座新建築物的高度

en.text: the developer pays a compensation to each affected household for blocking the sea view

zh.text: 該發展商向每一個受影響住戶就阻擋海景支付賠償

en.text: the affected households pay the developer to request it to reduce the height of the new building

zh.text: 受影響住戶向該發展商付費，要求它降低該座新建築物的高度

en.text: HKDSE 2025 Paper 1 Q21

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2025 卷一 第 21 題

en.text: When there is a negative externality, ______ occurs in the market and its efficient output level is ______ its equilibrium output level.

zh.text: 當有負面界外影響時，市場會出現 ______，而其有效率的產出水平會 ______ 其均衡產出水平。

en.text: overproduction ... above

zh.text: 過度生產 …… 高於

en.text: overproduction ... below

zh.text: 過度生產 …… 低於

en.text: underproduction ... above

zh.text: 生產不足 …… 高於

en.text: underproduction ... below

zh.text: 生產不足 …… 低於

en.text: HKDSE 2026 Paper 1 Q20

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2026 卷一 第 20 題
